name: 63012 · Barnhart, MO
findings: ZIP 63012 (Barnhart) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63012 (Barnhart) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 63012 (Barnhart) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
